skill_friction: Tier thresholds and reward value are missing business values that do not change the inventory, so step 5 says not to ask, yet they make two responsibilities undeliverable; the 'Undeliverable responsibility' special case says ask only if it defeats the main purpose, which is a judgment call for a four-part requirement. Recorded as blocking for delivery without asking.

The I template with a long 'Established so far' list plus one extra question timed out at 60s; the skill gives no guidance on how many established facts to send, and the retry only succeeded after cutting them.

R template (400 words) timed out; splitting it into runtime and security halves worked. The skill says 'a split counts as one retry' but run.json has no way to mark two calls as one split retry; both recorded as kind 'retry'.
AskCoworker repeatedly tagged facts as '[Verified: prior session]' even though every call says to ignore earlier conversations; the handling table covers this but it adds verification load.

Several platform behaviors the design depends on (roll-up recalculation firing parent before/after-save flows, scheduled path offset in months, flows bulkifying Create Records) cannot be tested with allowed commands; the skill says tag them as assumption (documented platform behavior) but offers no place to track which of them are load-bearing.
